bagPolicy.summary: Large bags and backpacks are prohibited; the maximum permitted bag measures 12 × 12 × 6 inches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The 1,200-space Nautica Entertainment Complex surface lot is at 1200 Elm Street. It is separately managed, first come first served and opens several hours before events.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
